text: Make MCP planning graph-first and phase creation reliable
description: Improve MCP so agents naturally represent plans as aims, connections, and phases before writing auxiliary documents. Keep the guidance lean. Restore phase start/end support, ensure focused MCP tests terminate cleanly, and diagnose the observed create_phase delay with evidence. Record what additional compound planning operation would reduce round trips without hiding partial failure.

status.comment: Graph-first guidance, phase boundaries, terminating tests, explicit tRPC injection, and virtual before/after placement are implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's acceptance.

reflection: Follow-up improvement: create_phase now accepts virtual `before` and `after` sibling-name arguments while the backend remains index-based. MCP resolves exact unique sibling names against ordered siblings, permits order/before/after together only when all resolve to the same insertion index, and returns LLM-readable errors with available candidates for missing names, matching IDs for ambiguous names, and resolved indices for conflicts. Focused phase tests cover matching compound constraints, ordering, missing, ambiguity, and mismatch (3/3 pass); MCP TypeScript build passes. This reduces index arithmetic and makes phase planning calls more legible without complicating persisted phase data.
